scientific_integrity: All results have a complete reproducible finite-quotient proof and an independently implemented direct labelled-state corroboration. No external independent scientific validation or publication-priority assessment is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic 3-state rule on two cliques of orders at least 2 joined by a single bridge; neither general multipartite systems, longer clique chains, stochastic updates nor other colors are covered. Computation is exhaustive on a rigorously established finite quotient. Historical priority outside inspected sources is uncertain.
title: Nine-step synchronization and exact first-entry layers for three-color fireflies on bridged cliques
